findings.note: ESPN's game log shows Mims with 1-2 catches in each of his last five games, including just 1 in each of the last two, with 11 catches on 18 targets in 2026; its blurb calls him an unappealing fantasy option for Friday's Steelers game.
A preview from one day ago says Sean Payton keeps calling it a priority to find new ways to get Mims the ball, but against the Raiders he had only three offensive touches and some snaps at fullback.
Preseason context: Courtland Sutton and the newly added Jaylen Waddle lead Denver's receivers, which limits targets for Mims as a depth receiver who also returns kicks and punts.
